text:
ana: quick sync  we pushed the header compacting shim and a few customers' per-intent dashboards lost the `intent` tag. total requests look normal. anyone else see this?
ben: yup, traces show the shim canonicalizer keeps only the first `x-route` occurrence in some proxy paths. example: `x-route: tenant=orbit` + `x-route: intent=trial` -> only tenant survives.
sylvie: that explains the sampling shard drift. our sampler keys on route.intent. if it disappears, traces collapse into DEFAULT buckets.
nana: (typo) ana: repro curl: `curl -H "x-route: tenant=orbit" -H "x-route: intent=trial" https://api.redwood.io/v1/complete`  telemetry shows tenant but no intent.
ben: mitigation options: 1) revert shim 2) server-side merge behavior 3) SDK emit fallback header (JSON or compact kv) 4) ingestion-side fallback.
sylvie: fastest is SDK fallback behind opt-in env var so we can canary. SDKs add `x-route-fallback` JSON when multiple `x-route` headers detected.
nana: keep header lowercase and small keys. recommend JSON: `{"tenant":"orbit","intent":"trial"}` but URL-encoded to avoid proxy stripping. also add compact `x-route-kv: tenant=orbit;intent=trial` as mobile fallback.
obs-bot: obs-team: we can wire ingestion to read `x-route-fallback` as a fallback in ~48h dev + 1d canary. Schema: flat strings, allowed keys tenant,intent,priority,feature. `x-route` takes precedence if present.
ben: SDK PR checklist: - opt-in env ROUTE_FALLBACK=1 - unit tests for header creation - docs + changelog note - avoid changing header casing/normalization in go/ts libs.
qa-bot: preflight checks: verify header size <8KB, URL-encode JSON, and add e2e mock with upstream proxy to ensure header survives.
sylvie: monitoring plan: 5% canary cohort with ROUTE_FALLBACK=1. compare sampled-trace parity: percentage of traces with `intent` present in logs vs telemetry. alert if mismatch > 10%.
nana: dev-bot, can you create a canary group and link ENG-PL-5122 + INGEST-1101?
dev-bot: created canary `route-fallback-canary-5pct`, linked ENG-PL-5122 and INGEST-1101. Canary starts in 15m.
ben: long-term: update shim to merge multi-valued `x-route` instead of overwrite. retire fallback after 2 weeks of parity.
sylvie: i'll open the SDK PRs for py/ts/go today and tag reviewers. will include both JSON and compact-kv emission behind the flag.
nana: thanks. i'll notify product ops and post updates in #incidents. :thumbsup:
